VERDICT write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/crew/directory.py, tests/test_a_coordinators_context_use_is_on_the_board.py, the evidence fragment and a figures directory; the two gained commits touch only directory.py, the test file and the fragment, all inside that scope.
VERDICT manifest: read; it records the repair head gate at e9d6656e16 as 6 passed EXIT=0 against 5 passed at a12116c0df, and a negative control of 1 failed/5 passed EXIT=1, all three logs present and readable on disk; its armed baseline row still records an exit-4 collection error as completed, which the previous review already recorded.
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit from a12116c0dfbd; e9d6656e16 is the reuse repair (directory.py now calls dispatch_accounting._latest_transcript and _jsonl_events) and f8917a71d76b is its evidence, 69 insertions against 36 deletions across three files, nothing outside the declared paths.

FINDING reckon/crew/directory.py:168 non-blocking: the forward fallback now reads through dispatch_accounting._jsonl_events, which opens the file with strict UTF-8, so a live transcript whose last line is torn mid-codepoint raises UnicodeDecodeError out of the board read; the inline reader this diff removed opened with errors="replace". Reproduced by passing _jsonl_events a file ending in b'"h\\xc3', which raises UnicodeDecodeError (probe in the run scratch), and the fallback is the path taken exactly when a multi-megabyte trailing tool result follows the last request.
